article.story: BOULDER, Colo. -- — Colorado sophomore Ian Inman scored 26 points on 8-for-13 shooting from 3-point range and the Buffaloes beat San Diego 83-75 on Tuesday night. Barrington Hargress scored 16 points, reserve Josiah Sanders 15 and Noah Feddersen 10. Alex Dickeson grabbed 10 rebounds for Colorado (2-1). The Buffs made 26 of 51 shot attempts. Davion Hill scored 20 points, Jevon Hill 18 and Dusty Stromer 11 for the Toreros (2-1). The Toreros led the entire first half and went to intermission up 37-34. Colorado had to outscore the Toreros 15-9 in the first seven minutes of the second half for its first lead of the game. Hargress's 23-foot, 3-pointer put Colorado up 49-46 with 13:14 to go. Terry McMorris's layup with 6:33 remaining capped a 12-7 surge to put the Toreros ahead 63-58. Colorado countered with 15-4 run and stayed ahead for the remainder of the game. Stromer's 23-foot shot from long range got San Diego within 75-72 with 1:24 left by it never got closer. Inman responded with a 3 23 seconds later to help Colorado seal it. Up next San Diego: Hosts Chicago State on Sunday. Colorado: Travels to face Providence on Saturday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
